runtime.name: claude-code
runtime.configuration: Native beta.4-to-beta.5 update in a fresh isolated profile; authenticated smoke uses that upgraded cache via --plugin-dir
runtime.permissionProfile: Read-only smoke, one child, USD 1 cap

assertions.evidence: Native list first showed enabled beta.4, native update reported beta.4 -> beta.5, and subsequent list showed enabled beta.5. Cached files passed install-release verify against the candidate manifest.
Copied existing user resolution and all 29 owned role files were preserved through update; setup-acceptance verified the user scope and hashes. No personal configuration was rewritten.

Earlier 70934f48-0f2b-416c-b969-26158a35bf33 incorrectly quoted a ROLE_POLICY footer as file text. After strengthening prove-it-works, session 7fa62730-7ba7-4e50-92c4-2321f604d8e7 completed one native how.explorer child; root read present.txt itself and correctly separated LIFECYCLE_OK from the child footer.

limitations: The isolated profile has no login (failed smoke 7b104bed-f492-4817-8934-91d8508c6632). Authenticated smoke loaded its upgraded bytes using --plugin-dir in the existing logged-in environment; it is not an authenticated session inside that isolated profile.
One route and one source-quotation regression do not certify all workflows.
